cau_hoi: Anh Docker dang ghim co chay duoc FreqAI khong?
ghi_chu_ke_toan: Chi kiem kha nang cua anh Docker (import thu vien). KHONG cham CALIB/WFO/LOCKBOX, khong danh gia cau hinh nao => 0 trial theo DR-014 §2. Khong tao state, khong ghi vao so nao.
ket_luan: THIEU. Anh dang ghim la bien the THUONG cua freqtrade, khong phai bien the _freqai. Thu muc freqtrade/freqai/ CO ton tai nhung KHONG import duoc vi thieu datasieve (phu thuoc cung cua tang pipeline FreqAI). => FreqAI khong chay duoc tren anh hien tai.
vi_sao_kiem_import_chu_khong_chi_kiem_th: Thu muc freqai/ ton tai la mot dau hieu HINH DANG; import duoc moi la CO CHE. Neu dung lai o 'thu muc co ton tai: True' thi ket luan se NGUOC HAN va sai. Cung bai hoc 08/09 (dung do tinh chat NGU NGHIA bang dau hieu CU PHAP).
he_qua: DIEU KIEN DUNG cua DR-FAI-01 §4(b) - viet TRUOC khi chay - da NO: 'TD-0219 cho thay anh Docker khong co thu vien ML => DUNG, trinh chu du an'.

Phep do §4(b) (thoi gian tuong mot luot backtest FreqAI) KHONG chay duoc, vi hai ly do doc lap: (1) anh khong import noi FreqAI; (2) repo co 0 dong chien luoc FreqAI (grep feature_engineering_expand_all / set_freqai_targets / freqaimodel => 0 ket qua), ma viet no = cham ma Khoi 17, thu DR-FAI-01 §0 cam khi con o trong.

Doi digest sang bien the _freqai lam doi runtime_image_digest - khoa xuat xu thu 8 => ban ghi ket qua truoc/sau KHONG so truc tiep duoc (hinh dang DR-D4-08 §8), va quy tac 9 (parity) doi local-staging-prod cung mot anh.
